investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Velus Mobile (mobile operator); Platform: Google Cloud asia-southeast1 (zones asia-southeast1-a/asia-southeast1-b/asia-southeast1-c); network range 10.193.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster velus-prod-asiaso (GKE); Database: mysql server plan-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall rule allow-plan-to-db; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
